payload.purpose_context: Today, running spec-kitty upgrade while a mission has live lane worktrees writes and commits the project's generated bookkeeping separately on every lane branch, and consolidate, review and implement then refuse the mission on a file the operator never touched. This mission makes upgrade write project-wide state once on the repository root checkout, teaches the integration checks to recognise that bookkeeping by rule, and lets missions already caught in the broken state land without manual edits.
payload.purpose_tldr: Upgrading Spec Kitty while a mission is in flight no longer blocks that mission from landing.

options: No: write once on the repository root checkout; skip integrating worktrees
payload.question: Should upgrade keep writing/committing project-global state in worktrees whose branch integrates back into the primary branch?

options: Only fully generated do-not-edit surfaces (.kittify/metadata.yaml), plus a content-identical overlap rule for the rest
payload.question: Which paths are classified as primary-owned bookkeeping that integration resolves to the primary side?

options: Simulate faithfully through the real CLI entry points; verbatim issue scripts against real old wheels as live evidence
payload.question: Do red-first tests install old CLI wheels or simulate the pre-upgrade state?

payload.final_answer: No: write once on the repository root checkout; skip integrating worktrees (operator brief Done-when 1; grounding §2/§4)
Only fully generated do-not-edit surfaces (.kittify/metadata.yaml), plus a content-identical overlap rule for the rest (grounding §3; #4933 lesson)
Simulate faithfully through the real CLI entry points; verbatim issue scripts against real old wheels as live evidence (operator brief §3.4 permits simulation; grounding §7)
